items.title_kr: Macy's, AI 기반 inventory replenishment tool 전격 도입
items.title_en: Macy’s rolls out AI inventory replenishment tool
items.body_kr: Macy's가 공급망 효율성과 merchandise 재고 관리를 고도화하기 위해 AI 기반의 inventory replenishment tool을 도입했습니다. 향후 vendor 파트너들과의 품목별 stock-level 최적화 및 reorder 프로세스에 긍정적인 영향이 기대됩니다.
items.body_en: Macy's has rolled out a new AI-driven inventory replenishment tool to streamline stock management. This system aims to improve efficiency in replenishment and stock optimization across retail channels.

items.title_kr: Lulus, Macy's 및 Bloomingdale's 중심의 wholesale channel 확장 본격화
items.title_en: Why Lulus is betting big on Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s, and wholesale in general
items.body_kr: 여성의류 브랜드 Lulus가 Macy's와 Bloomingdale's 등 주요 department store를 거점으로 wholesale channel 확장을 가속화하고 있습니다. 이는 vendor들에게 주요 retail 파트너를 통한 category별 입점 및 volume 확대 기회를 시사합니다.
items.body_en: Lulus is significantly increasing its wholesale footprint through major department stores like Macy's and Bloomingdale's. This strategic pivot highlights new opportunities for apparel vendors targeting major retail channels.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, Sephora 부진 만회 위해 Babies R Us shop-in-shop 56개점 대폭 확대
items.title_en: Kohl’s turns to Babies R Us as Sephora falters
items.body_kr: Kohl's is expanding its partnership with Babies R Us by rolling out 56 shop-in-shops to offset softening momentum in other categories. This store strategy focuses on capturing family traffic through dedicated kids' merchandise spaces.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, 최근 3개월간 주가 59% 급등하며 시장 기대감 상회
items.title_en: Abercrombie & Fitch Stock Climbs 59% in 3 Months: Is There More Upside?
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch가 성공적인 seasonal merchandise 기획과 탄탄한 sell-through에 힘입어 최근 3개월간 주가가 59% 급등했습니다. 지속적인 브랜드 리프레시와 정교한 inventory 관리가 실적 호조를 견인하고 있습니다.
items.body_en: Abercrombie & Fitch stock has climbed 59% over the past three months, driven by strong quarterly results and positive consumer demand. Efficient inventory control and successful seasonal assortments continue to fuel its market momentum.
